friends_page.what_this_work_description:
How to invite friends to be counted to you:

1. Post your invitation link in your profile

2. Click on the “Invite friends” button and select the dialog of the friends you want to invite

3. Post the story on Telegram with your invitation link (Telegram Premium owners only)

For a certain number of invited friends, you will receive an exclusive golden character, you can get acquainted with them in the “Friends” section

For each invited friend, you will receive a reward in the form of gold and a percentage of your friend's income, depending on whether he has Telegram Premium or not. A percentage of your friend's income will be credited to you every hour.

The second level of friends is when the friend you invited also invited another person. This person will be a second-level friend, for whom you will also receive a reward.
